source.symbol: macOS Preferences and Settings menu IDs
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
#ifdef XP_MACOSX
    <menuseparator id="prefSep"/>
    <!-- macOS 13 changed "Preferences" to "Settings" so one of these gets picked.
         We don't differentiate but we need to add both IDs. -->
    <menuitem id="menu_preferences"
              data-l10n-id="menu-tools-settings"
              key="key_preferencesCmdMac"
              oncommand="openPreferencesTab()"/>
    <menuitem id="menu_settings"
              data-l10n-id="menu-tools-settings"
              key="key_preferencesCmdMac"
              oncommand="openPreferencesTab()"/>
